subject: Logic
title: Bayes' Theorem Basics
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Bayes' Theorem Basics.

hook.text: You get new evidence. How much should it change your belief? Bayes' theorem gives the exact answer.

buildup.text: Start with a prior belief (before evidence). Update it with the likelihood of the evidence. Get a posterior belief.

discovery.text: P(H|E) = P(E|H) × P(H) / P(E). Prior times likelihood, divided by the total evidence probability.

twist.text: Thomas Bayes published the idea in 1763—posthumously. It was ignored for two centuries, then revolutionized AI.

climax.text: Bayesian reasoning is now the gold standard for updating beliefs rationally with new data.
